subject: MSA security exhibit: proposed audit playbook, pen-test window & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@medtechco.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James Kelly <james.kelly@procurement.medtechco.com>, security@medtechco.com
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit + audit cadence (MSA review)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for sending the MSA. As part of our procurement checklist we need to confirm the security exhibit details before we can advance the order form. Two items in particular: SOC 2 evidence cadence and the pen-test access window.

Specific asks:
- Can you confirm how often Redwood will provide SOC 2 evidence / control mappings? We typically ask for quarterly updates or a rolling evidence folder.
- For penetration testing: what is your standard window and what environment/staging access will you need?
- A short playbook describing what evidence you can share (logs, SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, remediation timelines) would be helpful.

Our legal team will also review the inspection right language; we can share redline suggestions once we have a proposed cadence.

Best,
Elaine Wong
Head of Security, MedTechCo
[external attachment: medtechco_svc_req.pdf (PDF)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@medtechco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit cadence (MSA review)

Elaine — thanks for the clear asks. I’ve pulled together a short proposal and attached an editable evidence matrix so you can mark what you need. High level responses: 

- SOC 2 evidence cadence: we can provide quarterly SOC 2 bridge letters and annual SOC 2 Type II reports. For customers requiring more frequent transparency, we offer a rolling evidence folder (read-only Google Drive link) with monthly key-control artifacts (config snapshots, change logs, and select audit logs) under an NDA/embedded access control.

- Pen-test window: standard window is a 2-week sandbox window against a non-prod environment we provision. We can support up to two concurrent customer-initiated tests per year; for additional tests we’d propose an ordered change request. Where customers need privileged inspection, we’ll scope privileged sessions with just-in-time credentials and an approved PSIRT contact.

- Playbook: attached is a 2-page playbook and an evidence matrix (editable). It lists typical artifacts, expected timelines for handoff, and escalation contacts. 

I’m looping in Karthik (legal) for redline/inspection-rights questions, and Marissa for the order form adjustments and SLA/commit alignment. Laura from Ops can speak to data retention and artifact retention policies.

Next steps I propose:
1) You mark required items in the evidence_matrix_medtechco.xlsx and return by EOD Tue 11 Aug.
2) Karthik will provide suggested MSA language for inspection rights by Wed 12 Aug.
3) We will propose a pen-test window the week of Aug 23 — is that feasible for your testing team?

Attachments: redlines_MSA_v3.pdf (proposed MSA changes; PDF), evidence_matrix_medtechco.xlsx (XLSX), pen_test_window_proposal.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — talk soon,
Hannah
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_MSA_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@medtechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit cadence (MSA review)

Elaine / Hannah — quick legal check-in on inspection / audit language. A few points from our side: 

- Inspection rights: we are comfortable with on-prem-ish "inspection" limited to the evidence folder and scoped in-scope artifacts. We are not able to provide full production access; any production-level sampling or privileged inspection will require a mutually agreed scope, PoC, and an NDA addendum.
- Timing: can we avoid language that implies unlimited right to "inspect" at any time? We prefer a time-boxed cadence (e.g., annual or quarterly with advance notice and mutually approved scope).
- Pen-test coordination: recommend language that requires an ops-approved test plan 7 business days prior and a 2-week window scheduling constraint. Any findings that require customer-impacting remediation will follow an agreed SLA.

I’ll put suggested redlines into the attached MSA PDF and also produce plain-text snippets you can paste into DocuSign if needed. Marissa: once Elaine confirms the cadence and artifacts, can you draft the matching order form clause for reserved capacity / dedicated throughput SLAs? We want the order form to call back to the exhibit for evidence and pen-test scheduling.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_MSA_v3.pdf (PDF) — legal annotations]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@medtechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit cadence (MSA review)

All — quick operational note from the commercial side. For deal MT-2026-092 I can align the order form to reference the security exhibit and the pen-test scheduling playbook. Two asks: 

1) Elaine — please confirm whether MedTechCo requires the rolling evidence folder (monthly artifacts) or the quarterly bridge-letter cadence. The rolling folder will impact our dedicated capacity terms if you opt-in for continuous evidence access.
2) Hannah / Karthik — if we keep the pen-test window in the third week of Aug (week of Aug 23), I need the final redline acceptance by Tue Aug 11 to meet our legal/ops cutover for the onboarding runbook.

If we get sign-off on the cadence and the limited inspection wording, I can update the order form and circulate a single consolidated PDF for signature.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: orderform_redline_stub.docx (DOCX)]

From: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@medtechco.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + audit cadence (MSA review)

Thanks everyone — quick answers from our side: 
- We prefer the rolling evidence folder for critical controls (monthly snapshots) for the first 6 months of the engagement, then switch to quarterly bridge letters thereafter. We will accept the time-boxed inspection language (quarterly with advance notice) and the ops-approved pen-test plan requirement.
- The week of Aug 23 for the pen-test window works for our team; we’ll send a short test plan by Aug 16.

Next: I’ll mark the evidence matrix today and return it. Once you send the consolidated MSA+orderform I’ll route for procurement / legal signature.

Elaine Wong
Head of Security, MedTechCo
